name: CAB Cakaran Corporation Berhad
overview: CAB 与 Oiltek Global 签署谅解备忘录，探讨在马来西亚成立合资企业，以棕油衍生物开发优质动物饲料原料；同时子公司 Pasaraya Jaya Gading 以 RM2,800,000 收购 Kuantan 一处工业物业。
overview_en: CAB signed a memorandum of understanding with Oiltek Global to explore a joint venture in Malaysia to develop premium animal feed ingredients using palm oil-derived products, while its subsidiary Pasaraya Jaya Gading acquired an industrial property in Kuantan for RM2,800,000.

segments.name: 综合家禽
segments.note: 与 Oiltek Global 探讨以棕油衍生物开发优质动物饲料原料的合资项目。
segments.note_en: Exploring a joint venture with Oiltek Global to develop premium animal feed ingredients using palm oil-derived products.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 Oiltek Global Pte Ltd 签署谅解备忘录，探讨在马来西亚成立合资企业，以棕油衍生物开发优质动物饲料原料。
actions.text_en: Signed a memorandum of understanding with Oiltek Global Pte Ltd to explore a strategic joint venture in Malaysia aimed at developing premium animal feed ingredients using palm oil-derived products.

segments.name: 零售
segments.note: 子公司 Pasaraya Jaya Gading 收购 Kuantan 一处工业物业。
segments.note_en: Subsidiary Pasaraya Jaya Gading acquired an industrial property in Kuantan.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Pasaraya Jaya Gading Sdn Bhd 以 RM2,800,000 收购位于 Pahang Kuantan 的 Semambu 工业区 Lot 54 一栋单层独立式工业建筑连双层办公室，面积约 3,904 平方米。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Pasaraya Jaya Gading Sdn Bhd acquired a single-storey detached industrial building with a double-storey office at Lot 54, Kawasan Perindustrian Semambu, Kuantan, Pahang, measuring approximately 3,904 square metres, for RM2,800,000.
